description: This file defines the MobileDevice class implementing MobileDeviceInterface, managing device features such as biometrics, storage, database, URL handling, and app state for a React Native mobile app.

classes.name: MobileDevice
classes.description: A class managing device-specific functionalities such as biometrics, storage, database, URL handling, and app state for a React Native mobile app.
